notes.title: Announcing Juice Fest! NextFest Edition
notes.content:
[h1]Hello [i]JUICERS[/i]![/h1]

[h3]You might have noticed [i](or not)[/i] that the [u]JUICE Demo[/u] has an [b]Arcade mode[/b], were you must eat 300 humans in the [b][i]least[/i][/b] amount of time:[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931004/dd7754373d4dd320feb53b3aea1c22ec2167fa2a.gif[/img]

[h3]Well...  starting today and [i]ending [/i]on October 21 the [u]BEST[/u] [b]10 players[/b] in the world with the [u]BEST[/u] Arcade speedrun times can compete to win:[/h3]

[list]
[b][*] A dope engraved Colorfiction hat of your choosing!
[*] A Big a$$ Juice prints made of archival paper and ink!
[*] Exclusive alpha/beta access to the game as it's developed!
[*] And my fave: the chance to be in game NPCs![/b]
[/list]
[h3]Super friggin Juicy right?[/h3]

[h2]Sooo how does this work? [i]EASY[/i]:[/h2]

1. Get [u][i]really good[/i][/u] at [b]Arcade mode[/b].

2. Post a [u]screenshot [/u]of your [b]best time[/b] on twitter or instagram with the #juicegamefest tag

3. and... [i]that's it! [/i]

After October 22 I'll scour socials, announce a list of best times, and reach out so you can claim these awesome juicy [b]prizes[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931004/8173bcc15e038a891c1206c31455ef9cb3ebd7f4.png[/img]

This past Pax East 2024 I held the first [i][b]Juice Fest[/b][/i], with thousands of players competing for similar prizes and it turned into a total feeding frenzy. Ultimately [b]6 champions[/b] triumphed and have since been immortalized:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931004/b68c11f0c4aec006678f487d0827fa2cf3889c7c.png[/img]

But tbh I think you can all totally [u]smoke [/u]these [i]fools[/i] and their best times (if yous og PAX champions are reading this whatsup! big hug, this is another chance to be the ultimate Juice champions).

[h2]What are you waiting for? [/h2]
[h1] GET [i]JUICING[/i]![/h1]
